description: This file defines an API for managing temporary object directories within a version control system, providing functions to create, manipulate, finalize, and clean up temporary object directories and to interface them as alternate object stores.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_create
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory with the specified prefix, returning NULL on failure.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_env
methods.description: Returns an array of environment strings suitable for using the temporary object directory with child processes.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_migrate
methods.description: Finalizes the temporary object directory by migrating its objects into the main object database, removing the temporary directory, and freeing resources.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a temporary object directory, discarding all contained objects.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_discard_objects
methods.description: Removes all objects from the temporary object directory while leaving the directory itself intact.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate
methods.description: Adds the temporary object directory as an alternate object store in the current process.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb
methods.description: Replaces the writable object store with the temporary object directory and optionally destroys it if 'will_destroy' is nonzero.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Restores the original primary object database if it was replaced by a temporary object directory, returning NULL if not replaced.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Reapplies the former primary object database, potentially with a different relative path.
